doc: Maps finding ids to recommended migration skills. Prefix lookup: stack_behind:frameworks:react → stack_behind.

cursor_rules_criterion.rationale: Fix formal quality issues in existing .mdc rules

node_eol.rationale: Node major is past security support

node_outdated.rationale: Bump Node one major at a time toward current LTS

yarn_classic.rationale: Yarn 1 (Classic) is unmaintained; migrate to Berry

yarn_berry_pre_v4.rationale: Yarn 2-3 are pre-stable Berry; align on Yarn 4

stack_behind.rationale: Bump the package toward npm latest — one major per PR when possible
manualSteps: Check release notes on npm for breaking changes
Run build, test, and lint before merge

stack_deprecated_npm.rationale: npm registry marks the installed version as deprecated — upgrade or replace
manualSteps: Read the deprecation message on npm
Move to the suggested replacement or latest non-deprecated major

stack_deprecated_list.rationale: Known unmaintained or blocked package — remove or replace
manualSteps: Run knip if the package is unused

profile_stale.rationale: Re-run stack detection so downstream audits use current profile
